newsitem.title: USA: Thermo BioAnalysis to buy biosystems group.
newsitem.headline: Thermo BioAnalysis to buy biosystems group.

text.p: Thermo BioAnalysis Corp said on Tuesday that it agreed to buy the Biosystems Group of Life Sciences International for $91.5 million from Thermo Instrument Systems Inc, which is the majority owner of Thermo BioAnalysis.
Thermo Instruments, in turn, is controlled by Thermo Electron.

The purchase price, subject to a post-closing adjustment, will partly be satisfied by the issuance of $16.9 million of Thermo BioAnalysis common stock. The purchase price also will be adjusted upward to include an amount equal to the cash held by the acquired companies, Thermo BioAnalysis said.

The Biosystems Group consists primarily of the Hybaid unit, based in the United Kingdom, which makes thermal cyclers and consumables for DNA amplification, and Finland-based Labsystems, which makes microplate-based immunoassay instruments and liquid-handling equipment.
Thermo Instrument Systems bought Life Sciences International in March 1997.
Thermo BioAnalysis makes instrumentation and information management systems for biochemical research and production and clinical diagnostics.
